_comment: Resolved incidents used for precedent matching by engine/precedent.py. Matching is lexical today over the normalised signature; see that module's docstring for the embedding swap. Add one entry per incident you hand-classify. Nothing here is generated by a model.
_signature_note: signature is the normalised failure shape: exception chain, then the distinguishing inner symptom. Never paste a raw stack trace here. GUIDs, timestamps and thread ids drown the real signal.

incidents.title: Supplier sync failed on every batch above 400 records
incidents.resolution: Traced to the read timeout on the SAT gateway route, set to 60s. Chunked the supplier call to 250 records per request as an interim fix. Sync has run clean since.

incidents.title: Address sync cut at one minute on month-end volume
incidents.resolution: Same ceiling as INC-2026-0731-014 but on the address route. Confirmed by running the same payload split in two, both halves succeeded.

incidents.title: HttpClient timeout raised to 300s, failures continued
incidents.resolution: Raised the client timeout on the assumption the client was cutting the call. Failures continued at the same 60s mark, which is what proved the cutter was upstream of the client. Change was reverted.

incidents.title: Galileo platform maintenance overran its window
incidents.resolution: Planned Galileo maintenance ran two hours past its slot. All batch sizes failed identically. Sync re-run after platform recovery.

incidents.title: Firewall rule change blocked the worker subnet
incidents.resolution: A firewall change removed the egress rule for the worker subnet. No request left the host. Rule restored.

incidents.title: Service account password expired
incidents.resolution: The service account password expired overnight and the worker would not start. Account moved to a non-expiring service principal.

incidents.title: Connection pool exhausted during overlapping runs
incidents.resolution: Two sync cycles overlapped and exhausted the pool. Found a leaked connection in the retry path rather than raising Max Pool Size.

incidents.title: Client secret expired without rotation alert
incidents.resolution: The client secret reached its two-year expiry. Rotated and added a 30-day expiry alert.

incidents.title: Upstream feed failure left the supplier view empty
incidents.resolution: The nightly feed populating vw_SupplierDetails failed silently. The sync exited cleanly with zero rows and raised no alert for two days.

incidents.title: Retry storm after an oversized batch failure
incidents.resolution: An automatic retry re-sent the same oversized batch four times, each failing at 60s and multiplying load on the gateway. Retry on this path was made size-aware.
